areas.label: 개인 농장 5×3
areas.note: 15개 농장칸. 방·밭·목초지 바닥은 한 칸 단위이고, 사람·가축·작물·외양간은 칸/목초지 위에 놓이는 겹침 상태. 시작 목재 방은 왼쪽 열의 중·하단 칸. 울타리는 아래 JSON의 경계 ID를 사용.

areas.label: 기본 행동 공간
areas.note: 기본 행동 공간. 각 칸에는 행동한 가족원 1명만 놓고, 누적 공간은 자원을 겹쳐 보유하므로 누적 자원량은 별도 상태입니다.

areas.label: 2인 선택 추가 행동 타일
areas.note: 공식 부록의 2인 선택 타일 네 칸. 설정에 따라 타일을 도입하지 않는 경우가 있어 선택 상태를 별도로 보존.

areas.label: 3·4인 추가 타일 2칸
areas.note: 3·4인용 추가 타일의 Animal Market·Modest Wish 선택 공간. 한 라운드에 타일 자체는 한 번만 사용 가능.

areas.label: 개인 자원·사용 설비
areas.note: 자원 보유량과 이미 사용한 직업·보조/주요 설비를 배치하는 개인 영역. 용량 상한은 없으며 같은 종류의 자원은 수량으로 보존.

areas.note: 개정판 기본판 주요 설비 10장. 실제 카드 종류는 구매/건설 후 개인 설비 영역으로 이동하며 공용 공급에서 제거.

areas.note: 공용 공급 자원 카테고리. 이 도식 아이콘은 수량을 나타내지 않으며 수량은 tableModel.generalSupply 기준.

areas.note: 선택한 소유자에게만 보이는 직업/보조 설비 손패. 소유권과 카드 순서는 그대로 보존.

notes: Agricola Revised Edition (2016) base game, 1–4 players; not the 2007 five-player edition and not the 5–6 player expansion.
Dashed farm boundary marks indicate available fence placements only. The initial farm has no fences built.
Action card identities and resources accumulated on action spaces vary during play and are modeled as state rather than printed labels.
The SVG is an original neutral diagram and does not reproduce commercial Agricola artwork or card text.

Farm-cell geometry is fixed for the 15 printed spaces; fence state is represented on 38 independent boundaries so a later consumer can record enclosure topology without inventing a rectangular fixed pasture layout.

structureEvidence.location: Rules pp.2–4, Revised Edition 2016 setup/board/component description
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 1–4 player base edition; 3×5 farmyard; 14 round cards grouped 4/3/2/2/2/1; 10 public major improvements; 5 family members, 4 stables and 15 fences per player; starting two wood rooms occupied by two people.

structureEvidence.location: Official appendix pp.6–7, action spaces and 2/3/4-player action-space variants
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Common accumulation/action-space identities and 2-player four-choice optional tile; 3/4-player supplemental two-action tile; 3-player and 4-player extension spaces and Lessons costs.

structureEvidence.location: Official appendix pp.10–11, farm scoring/animal accommodation; rules pp.8–9
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: 15-cell farmyard; fences form closed pastures across cell edges; stable/pasture animal capacity and room pet capacity; crop/animal overlays remain farm-cell state.

structureEvidence.location: Official product page, revised edition edition/player-count clarification
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Revised 2016 base edition supports 1–4 players; five-player mode belongs to separate expansion.

assetScope: Whole-table Agricola Revised Edition 2016 base game reference: farmyard, fence topology, public action spaces/round cards/major improvements, resource supply, personal stock, and owner-private hand zones.

tableModel.purpose: Self-contained visual/state reference for a later consumer. Contains board geometry and semantic state coordinates; it does not implement rules, validation, or an application editor.

tableAreas.semantics: 15 fixed farm cells with overlaid room/field/pasture tile states, occupants, animals, crops, stable and fence-boundary references.
10 public common action spaces; a family member and any accumulated resources are separate overlapping state layers.
Optional four-space 2-player variant tile; tile-use lock and selected action are distinct state.
Optional shared two-space tile for 3-/4-player modes; one tile use per round.
Player-scoped resources and played occupation/improvement cards; no fixed storage capacity.
Four public round-card positions for rounds 1–4.
Three public round-card positions for rounds 5–7.
Two public round-card positions for rounds 8–9.
Two public round-card positions for rounds 10–11.
Two public round-card positions for rounds 12–13.
One public round-card position for round 14.
Ten public major improvement cards; selected card identity moves to an owning player tableau when built.
Shared resource supply; pictograms indicate categories only and do not encode remaining count.
Owner-private occupation/minor-improvement cards and their order.

twoPlayerVariant.tileUse: A player selects one of four spaces; the supplemental tile is blocked for the rest of that round.

threeFourSupplementalTile.tileUse: Only one person may use this tile each round.

actionState.workerPlacement: one family member per action space per round
actionState.resourceAccumulation: store a collection of independently countable resource tokens on marked accumulation spaces
actionState.roundCard: round card identity/face state is independent from worker/resource overlay
actionState.harvest: preserve each harvest checkpoint and any in-progress phase marker

playerTableau.fields: A player's hand remains owner-private; played cards and stock belong to that player.

generalSupply.quantityMeaning: Official Revised base-game component quantities; tokens in the supply can be depleted and returned during play.

visualModel.farmCells: 15 square cells with individually addressable edges
visualModel.fenceEdges: 38 distinct dashed placement guides; all start unbuilt
visualModel.actionSpaces: colored neutral card-like slots; action identity is bound by stable slotId in this JSON
visualModel.cardZones: round cards and public major-improvement supply have fixed positions; identities/face state are data
visualModel.supplyPictograms: category indicators only; they do not encode remaining quantity
visualModel.majorImprovements: Ten separate card slots, each with an original neutral facility/tool pictogram; exact card identity is bound by stable slotId in this model.

limits: This is a complete static board asset and declarative table-state schema; it does not include application integration or a game-rules engine.
This package is a whole-board asset and semantic layout only; no app integration or game-rules engine is included.
The two-player supplemental action tile and 3-/4-player supplemental tile are optional setup variants documented in the official appendix.
Occupation/minor-improvement decks and hands are variable; the asset reserves semantic hand/played-card zones rather than fixed card identities.
No extension deck, five-/six-player expansion, or optional Side Job tile is included.
